items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: I DIDN'T MEET HIM THROUGH YOU. I MET HIM THROUGH BUDDY TATE.

ctx.x: We had a thing going doing that. Crook would make his banjo sound like a harp. He had something that nobody else had on that thing. It's hard to explain.
(inaudible) TONE CHAMBER OR WHATEVER IT WAS.
